name: T2VWorldBench
description: T2VWorldBench is the first systematic evaluation framework for assessing the world knowledge generation abilities of text-to-video models, covering 6 major categories and 1,200 prompts across diverse domains, using both human and automated evaluations.
reputation: A very recent benchmark that has not yet seen broad community adoption, but is notable as the first systematic evaluation of text-to-video world knowledge generation.
notes: Highlights a critical gap in current text-to-video models' ability to leverage world knowledge for semantic consistency and factual accuracy.
